title: 10. Exercises: Topic 4: Polymorphism - Exercises
summary: Create a vehicle hierarchy with base class Vehicle and subclasses Car, Motorcycle, and Truck.
objectives: Solve the Topic 4: Polymorphism - Exercises exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercise 1: Vehicle Hierarchy with Polymorphism
sections.body:
Create a vehicle hierarchy with base class `Vehicle` and subclasses `Car`, `Motorcycle`, and `Truck`. Implement:
- Method overriding for `start_engine()`, `stop_engine()`, and `get_info()`
- Polymorphic collection processing
- Different engine sounds and fuel consumption rates
- Operator overloading for comparison (by fuel efficiency)

sections.title: Exercise 2: Media Player with Duck Typing
sections.body:
Create a media player system that demonstrates duck typing:
- Classes: `AudioPlayer`, `VideoPlayer`, `StreamingPlayer`
- Common interface: `play()`, `pause()`, `stop()`, `get_duration()`
- Duck typing function that works with any object having these methods
- Handle missing methods gracefully with try/except

sections.title: Exercise 3: Mathematical Operations with Operator Overloading
sections.body:
Create a `ComplexNumber` class with:
- Operator overloading for `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `==`, `!=`
- Methods for `conjugate()`, `magnitude()`, `angle()`
- Support for operations with real numbers
- String representation and comparison operators

sections.title: Exercise 4: Database Connection Polymorphism
sections.body:
Create a database connection system with:
- Abstract base class `DatabaseConnection`
- Subclasses: `MySQLConnection`, `PostgreSQLConnection`, `SQLiteConnection`
- Polymorphic methods: `connect()`, `execute_query()`, `close()`
- Different connection parameters and query syntax

sections.title: Exercise 5: Notification System with Polymorphism
sections.body:
Create a notification system with:
- Base class `Notification` with abstract methods
- Subclasses: `EmailNotification`, `SMSNotification`, `PushNotification`
- Polymorphic `send()` method with different implementations
- Template method pattern for notification processing

sections.title: Exercise 6: Shape Calculator with Method Overriding
sections.body:
Create a shape calculation system with:
- Base class `Shape` with abstract `area()` and `perimeter()` methods
- Subclasses: `Circle`, `Rectangle`, `Triangle`, `Ellipse`
- Method overriding for area and perimeter calculations
- Polymorphic collection processing for multiple shapes

sections.title: Exercise 7: File Format Converter with Duck Typing
sections.body:
Create a file format converter system:
- Classes: `TextConverter`, `ImageConverter`, `AudioConverter`
- Common interface: `convert()`, `get_supported_formats()`, `validate_file()`
- Duck typing function that processes any converter object
- Handle different input/output formats

sections.title: Exercise 8: Payment Gateway with Polymorphism
sections.body:
Create a payment gateway system with:
- Abstract base class `PaymentGateway`
- Subclasses: `StripeGateway`, `PayPalGateway`, `BankGateway`
- Polymorphic methods: `process_payment()`, `refund()`, `get_transaction_status()`
- Different payment processing logic and response formats

sections.title: Exercise 9: Data Structure with Operator Overloading
sections.body:
Create a `Vector` class with:
- Operator overloading for `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `==`, `!=`, `[]`
- Methods for `dot_product()`, `cross_product()`, `magnitude()`
- Support for scalar operations and vector operations
- Indexing and slicing operations

sections.title: Exercise 10: Game Character System with Polymorphism
sections.body:
Create a game character system with:
- Base class `Character` with abstract methods
- Subclasses: `Warrior`, `Mage`, `Archer`, `Healer`
- Method overriding for `attack()`, `defend()`, `special_ability()`
- Polymorphic combat system and character management

sections.title: Optional Challenges
sections.body:
### Challenge 1: Advanced Operator Overloading
Implement a `Matrix` class with:
- Full matrix arithmetic operations
- Determinant and inverse calculations
- Eigenvalue and eigenvector computation
- Matrix comparison and sorting

### Challenge 2: Plugin System with Duck Typing
Create a plugin system where:
- Plugins implement a common interface
- Dynamic loading of plugins at runtime
- Duck typing for plugin discovery and execution
- Plugin versioning and compatibility checking

### Challenge 3: Expression Parser with Polymorphism
Build an expression parser with:
- Abstract base class for expressions
- Subclasses for different operators and operands
- Polymorphic evaluation and simplification
- Operator precedence and associativity

### Challenge 4: Event System with Polymorphism
Implement an event-driven system with:
- Abstract base class for events
- Different event types with specific data
- Polymorphic event handlers and processors
- Event filtering and routing

### Challenge 5: Configuration System with Duck Typing
Create a configuration system with:
- Different configuration sources (file, database, API)
- Duck typing for configuration access
- Polymorphic configuration validation
- Dynamic configuration updates
